title: The plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'hover_custom_background' parameter in…
description: A WordPress plugin is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via the 'hover_custom_background' parameter in all versions up to and including 9.1. The vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing authenticated users with contributor-level access or higher to inject malicious scripts. The wp_kses_post function does not sanitize shortcode attribute text properly, enabling injected double-quotes to break out of the style attribute context and execute arbitrary scripts when a user views the affected page.
